subject: Robotis Lab: plan ready; implement Webots next
body: Project brief: projects/robotis-lab/brief.md. Planning docs created for user as downloads; no Webots code or robot hardware execution yet. Next phase: audit actual inventory, then build testable 25-cm 10-DOF Webots model/controller. Cloud AI must not control servo safety loop. Avoid asserting <3m VND can deliver unsupported walking.
